text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how many times Haru Urara
loses, she
never gives up!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been hearing more and more people
praise
Haru Urara for her tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Winning is so hard! Everyone
whooshed right
past me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Um, well...
choice_data_list: どうしたら勝てると思う？
choice_data_list_en: How do you think we can win?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I should enter a race where
it's only
me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Then there's no way to lose!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? I thought I struck gold for a
second
there.
choice_data_list: それはレースとは言わないかな……
choice_data_list_en: I don't think you can really call that a race...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Ah, is that Haru Urara? Hey there!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Who said my name?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You've been trying so hard! I'm rooting
for you!

text_block_list.name: Passerby C
text_block_list.text: Hey! It's that plucky Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh! You know who I am?

text_block_list.name: Passerby D
text_block_list.text: Of course! We're in your fan club!

text_block_list.name: Passerby E
text_block_list.text:
I love that you keep going no matter
how many
times you lose! Don't ever
give up!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! Yeah! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I feel like an idol! I'm glad I've
worked so
hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Everyone is so excited to see me race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I wanna race even more! Then they'll really be excited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara's motivation skyrockets! It
was a good
idea for her to enter races to
gain experience and
grow her fanbase.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay!
choice_data_list: この調子でレースに出続けよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's keep entering races with this momentum!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps by having her enter races, Haru Urara will find a race to aspire to... Once she finds that dream race, I'll do whatever I can to help her reach it and win!
